title: Pig wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='32' ry='22' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#ffc4d8'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='86' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e88ba8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='86' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e88ba8'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='94' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c96b88'/>
  <rect x='60' y='94' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c96b88'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#ffc4d8'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='26' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#f7a8c4' transform='rotate(-20 24 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='26' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#f7a8c4' transform='rotate(20 76 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='26' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e88ba8' transform='rotate(-20 24 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='26' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e88ba8' transform='rotate(20 76 26)'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#4a2530'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#4a2530'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#e88ba8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#d4789a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#b8557a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#b8557a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 66 58 60' stroke='#c96b88' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,4 36,28 64,28' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <polygon points='50,4 44,28 56,28' fill='#45b7ae'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='42,22 58,22 55,28 45,28' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <polygon points='45,14 55,14 53,20 47,20' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- Hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <!-- Hat brim highlight -->
  <line x1='37' y1='28' x2='63' y2='28' stroke='#3aa8a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
